flags.question: Which users have provided answers to the question with the title 'even after null check why I am getting null value in neo4j?' Limit to the top 3.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (q:Question {title: 'even after null check why I am getting null value in neo4j?'})<-[:ANSWERED]-(a:Answer)<-[:PROVIDED]-(u:User)
RETURN u.display_name AS user
LIMIT 3
details: Question asks for top-3 but Cypher has no ORDER BY

flags.question: Identify the 3 answers with the lowest scores provided to the most viewed questions.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (q:Question)-[:ANSWERED]-(a:Answer)
WITH q, a
ORDER BY q.view_count DESC
LIMIT 1
WITH a
ORDER BY a.score ASC
LIMIT 3
RETURN a.link AS answer_link, a.title AS answer_title, a.score AS answer_score
details: TypeQL uses reduce...count but Cypher has no COUNT()

flags.question: What are the top 5 questions with the highest number of answers?

MATCH (q:Question)
RETURN q.title, q.link, q.answer_count
ORDER BY q.answer_count DESC
LIMIT 5
details: Question asks "how many" but Cypher has no COUNT()

flags.question: Show the first 5 questions where the accepted answer was provided by a user who has answered more than 50 questions.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (q:Question)-[:ANSWERED]-(a:Answer)-[:PROVIDED]-(u:User)
WHERE a.is_accepted = true
WITH u, q, COUNT(a) AS answer_count
WHERE answer_count > 50
RETURN q.link, q.title, q.creation_date
ORDER BY q.creation_date
LIMIT 5
details: TypeQL uses try{}/custom function but Cypher has no OPTIONAL MATCH

flags.question: What are the 3 most recent comments on the question with the highest view count?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (q:Question)
WITH q
ORDER BY q.view_count DESC
LIMIT 1
MATCH (c:Comment)-[:COMMENTED_ON]->(q)
RETURN c
ORDER BY c.uuid DESC
LIMIT 3

flags.question: List all the comments made by the user with the highest comment score.
flags.cypher:
// Step 1: Find the user with the highest comment score
MATCH (u:User)-[:COMMENTED]->(c:Comment)
WITH u, MAX(c.score) AS maxScore
MATCH (u)-[:COMMENTED]->(c:Comment)
WHERE c.score = maxScore

// Step 2: Retrieve all comments made by this user
MATCH (u)-[:COMMENTED]->(allComments:Comment)
RETURN u.display_name AS user, allComments.uuid AS comment_id, allComments.link AS comment_link, allComments.score AS comment_score
details: TypeQL uses sort but Cypher has no ORDER BY

flags.question: What are the top 3 questions with the highest number of tags and answers?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (q:Question)-[:TAGGED]->(t:Tag)
WITH q, COUNT(t) AS tag_count
MATCH (q)-[:ANSWERED]->(a:Answer)
WITH q, tag_count, COUNT(a) AS answer_count
RETURN q.title AS question_title, q.link AS question_link, tag_count, answer_count
ORDER BY tag_count DESC, answer_count DESC
LIMIT 3
details: Cypher has (Question)-[:ANSWERED]->(Answer) but schema says Answer->Question

flags.question: List the top 3 most answered questions and their accepted answers.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (q:Question)-[:ANSWERED]-(a:Answer)
WHERE q.answer_count > 0
WITH q, COUNT(a) AS answerCount
ORDER BY answerCount DESC, q.view_count DESC
LIMIT 3
MATCH (q)-[:ANSWERED]->(acceptedAnswer:Answer)
WHERE acceptedAnswer.is_accepted = true
RETURN q.title AS questionTitle, q.link AS questionLink, acceptedAnswer.link AS acceptedAnswerLink, acceptedAnswer.body_markdown AS acceptedAnswerBody
details: Cypher has (Question)-[:ANSWERED]->(Answer) but schema says Answer->Question

flags.question: What are the top 3 tags used in the most viewed questions?

MATCH (q:Question)-[:TAGGED]->(t:Tag)
WITH t, SUM(q.view_count) AS total_views
ORDER BY total_views DESC
LIMIT 3
RETURN t.name AS tag, total_views
